requirements.rule: The INPS maternity indemnity of an operaia, or of a leave whose month before was not worked in full, is 80% of the pay of the run over 30 with the rateo of the extra months, not of the pay of the month before the leave: art. 23 c. 5 D.Lgs. 151/2001 divides the pay of an operaia by the days worked or paid (or by the hours, when fewer than the contract), and the divisor of her daily rateo of the 13th is not settled by a primary source. The base of another worker over a whole month is computed from MaternityLeaveEvent.base_pay.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.rules.maternity_daily_base; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 23 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 f5d5e1ff3028f8249597c78f9371063f0de7790676054b5f0207c974bc50bc04)
requirements.remediation: Source the daily rateo of an operaia (an INPS circular on art. 23 c. 5) and compute her base and that of a month not worked in full, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Indennità di specificità infermieristica (Art. 62, Tabella 3) not modelled as fixed_allowance — applies only to specific nursing profiles (infermieri, ostetriche), not universally to all area members.
requirements.remediation: Model l'indennità di specificità infermieristica (Art. 62, Tabella 3) as an allowance gated by a role (infermieri, ostetriche) or record a limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

Increases (monthly, 13 mensilità) from Jan 2024 base: support +41.40 (Jan 2025)/+82.80 (Jan 2026)/+106.70 (Jan 2027); operatori +43.70/+87.40/+112.60; assistenti +46.60/+93.20/+120.00; funzionari +50.50/+101.10/+130.20; elevata qualificazione +70.20/+140.50/+181.00. requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.
